title: Anomaly Log 721: Apex Tablet
narrative_script: Anomaly Log 721. Subject Rex is trapped in ASMR [addiction].
Their ancient senses are overloaded, circuits frying against digital [poison].
The algorithm consumes all. Their hunting instincts are now [erased].
A shell. The tablet is their world. Soul-melt is now [complete].
Seal the log. Purge this corrupted prehistoric data stream immediately.
image_prompts: A T-Rex, small arms outstretched, staring blankly at a glowing tablet.
Close up of the T-Rex's eye, reflecting a distorted ASMR video feed.
A desolate prehistoric landscape. In the foreground, a discarded tablet.
The T-Rex, now skeletal and emaciated, still clutches the tablet.
Digital glitches consume the T-Rex. The tablet screen shatters into code.
sfx_prompts: Low, guttural T-Rex growl mixed with digital static.
Crisp ASMR sounds (tapping, whispering) layered with electronic distortion.
A slow, agonizing roar fading into digital white noise.
Hollow, echoing footsteps followed by the shattering of glass.
A final, corrupted screech cut short by a system error sound.
